product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet King Street Industrial Four-Drawer Media Console Table, Walnut, Black Metal, Glass
product.description: Wooden drawers appear to float, under a tempered glass top, in a metal frame on this modern coffee table. Place your drinks and snacks on top, while storing your remote controls and chargers in the handy drawers underneath. 47.2"L x 15.7"W x 31.5"H Engineered wood, walnut veneer drawers, metal legs and transparent glass top Modern Industrial Two drawers provide storage space No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
